title: Provider Manual, Prepaid Dental HMO Plans: Specialist Referral Standards
content:
**Standard.** Under the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans, a specialist service is covered only under a referral requested by the assigned primary care dentist and approved by Cascade, to a specialist holding an active Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement, and only if performed on or before the referral's valid-through date (issue date plus the plan's referral valid days).

Routine referrals are decided within the plan's referral turnaround in business days; a referral is approved when the procedure is beyond the scope of general dentistry for the case, and a child may be referred to a pediatric dentist only before the pediatric dentist referral age limit birthday.

A specialist service without a valid referral is recorded as having no valid referral and the member owes the specialist's usual fee; the specialist copay follows the plan's specialist copay basis.

---

**Conditions for a covered specialist service.** All of the following hold for the specialist service to be covered:

1. A referral exists that the member's assigned primary care dentist requested.
2. Cascade approved the referral.
3. The specialist holds a Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement that is active.
4. The service is performed on or before the referral's valid-through date.

If any of the four fails, the service is not covered under the referral; a service without a valid referral leaves the member owing the specialist's usual fee.

**The valid-through date.** It is the referral issue date plus the plan's referral valid days, counted in calendar days. A service on the valid-through date itself is within it; a service on the day after is not.

| Service date (hypothetical referral issued 1 June, 90 valid days) | Within the valid-through date of 30 August? |
|---|---|
| 29 August | Yes |
| 30 August | Yes |
| 31 August | No — no valid referral; the specialist's usual fee |

**Decision on a referral request.** A routine referral request is decided within the plan's referral turnaround, counted in business days. A referral is approved when the procedure is beyond the scope of general dentistry for the case.

**Pediatric dentist referrals.** A child may be referred to a pediatric dentist only before the birthday set as the plan's pediatric dentist referral age limit. Hypothetical illustration on a plan whose limit is the 8th birthday: a referral for a child of 7 years and 11 months is within the limit; a referral for a child who turned 8 last week is not.

**Copay under a valid referral.** The specialist copay follows the plan's specialist copay basis, under which specialist services carry the same copays as the schedule.

**Hypothetical case.** A primary care dentist requests a referral for a molar root canal to an endodontist with an active Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement; Cascade approves it. The endodontist performs the root canal within the valid-through date. The member owes the plan's scheduled molar root canal copay. Had the root canal been done after the valid-through date, it would have had no valid referral and the member would owe the endodontist's usual fee.
